def legacy(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    gate_rows=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row))>1 and all(v!=bg for v in row):
            triple=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=row[0]]
            if len(triple)==3: gate_rows.append(r)
    isolated=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) if r not in gate_rows for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    endpoints=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,6,1,8,3)]
    if endpoints[0][0] in gate_rows:
        endpoints=isolated
    color=endpoints[0][2]
    points=[(r,c) for r,c,v in endpoints]
    gates=set()
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row))>1 and all(v!=bg for v in row):
            triple=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=row[0]]
            if len(triple)==3:
                points.append((r,triple[1])); gates.add(r)
    points.sort()
    for (r1,c1),(r2,c2) in zip(points,points[1:]):
        start=r1+1 if r1 in gates else r1
        end=r2-1 if r2 in gates else r2
        for r in range(start,end+1): out[r][c1]=color
        if c2 < 0 or c2 >= len(grid[0]):

            for c,v in enumerate(grid[r2]):

            out[r2][c1]=color
        else:
            for c in range(min(c1,c2),max(c1,c2)+1): out[end][c]=color
            if r2 in gates: out[r2][c2]=color
    return out

def standard(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    gates=[]
    endpoints=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        special=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
        if special and all(v!=bg for v in row) and len(set(row))>1:
            triple=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=row[0]]
            if len(triple)==3: gates.append((r,triple[1]))
        elif special:
            endpoints.extend((r,c) for c in special)
    color=grid[endpoints[0][0]][endpoints[0][1]]
    points=sorted(endpoints+gates)
    gate_rows={r for r,c in gates}
    for (r1,c1),(r2,c2) in zip(points,points[1:]):
        start=r1+1 if r1 in gate_rows else r1
        end=r2-1 if r2 in gate_rows else r2
        for r in range(start,end+1): out[r][c1]=color
        for c in range(min(c1,c2),max(c1,c2)+1): out[end][c]=color
        if r2 in gate_rows: out[r2][c2]=color
    return out

import re
# Extract all newly shown demo pairs directly from the session log.
new_pairs=[]
for line in log.read_text().splitlines():
    d=json.loads(line); m=d.get('message',{})
    if m.get('role')!='user': continue
    text='\n'.join(c.get('text','') for c in m.get('content',[]) if c.get('type')=='text')
    for match in re.finditer(r'Demo pair \d+ input \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \d+ output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?:\n\nSame instance|\Z)',text,re.S):
        def parse_grid(s): return [[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in s.strip().splitlines()]
        new_pairs.append({'input':parse_grid(match.group(1)),'output':parse_grid(match.group(2))})
all_pairs=pairs[:]
for p in new_pairs:
    if p not in all_pairs: all_pairs.append(p)
(progdir/'task-7fabad79.json').write_text(json.dumps(all_pairs))
assert len(new_pairs)==3 and len(all_pairs)==19
assert all(mod.transform(p['input'])==p['output'] for p in all_pairs)
